Step 3. The idempotent operator \(V_{01290013}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle V_{01290013} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via linear interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01290011 \cdot C_01290012 \cdot C_01290013\).
